note: Golden + edge vectors for the dispute deadline and evidence producer across four payment service providers (psp-deadline-tables-2026). Finding: per-PSP deadline tables as data - Stripe, Adyen and Square each contribute their own stage vocabulary and stated deadline rules from their 2026-10 snapshots (stripe-disputes-2026-10, adyen-disputes-2026-10, square-disputes-2026-10, each fetch 2026-10-26T12Z); a window stated only as a range, a typical figure, or not at all is returned null with the reason quoted, never guessed; sources: Adyen A5 timeframe matrix (NoC 40 days Mastercard, RFI 14 days Amex, TWINT 10 days; visa 9-or-18 and Klarna 14/7/96h ambiguities refused as NOT STATED), Stripe S3 120-day inquiry auto-close, Square Q3 typical figure + Q4 due_at passthrough. Coverage: all four disputes.js reasons (including missing-evidence shapes), past-due inquiry, seller_response_due_date passthrough, the three PayPal stage-scoping branches, NOT STATED deadline postures for chargeback and both appeal stages, six PayPal refusals, and the new PSP paths: one table-driven vector per PSP rule family plus CE3.0-shaped bundle emission (stripe needs_response on a card rail; adyen NoC on card schemes only, withheld for TWINT; square EVIDENCE_REQUIRED), passthrough per PSP deadline field, and three new refusals (unknown psp, stage-vocabulary mismatch, funding_source on a non-PayPal path). Every deadline number is PSP-stated via its snapshot; NOT STATED windows are null with a reason. The first 18 PayPal vectors are the original golden set, byte-identical.
